# artifactkeeper_repository_cache_ttl (Resource)

Per-repository cache TTL: how long, in seconds, cached upstream artifacts stay fresh before a remote repository re-fetches them. A singleton keyed by repository key: no create/delete (the value lives with the repository), and writes upsert.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cache upstream artifacts for one hour before the remote repository re-fetches them.
resource "artifactkeeper_repository_cache_ttl" "npm_proxy" {
  repository_key    = artifactkeeper_repository.npm_proxy.key
  cache_ttl_seconds = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cache_ttl_seconds` (Number) How long, in seconds, cached artifacts stay fresh before being re-fetched from upstream.
- `repository_key` (String) Key of the repository whose cache TTL is managed. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Equal to `repository_key`, since the config is a singleton per repository.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artifactkeeper_repository_cache_ttl.npm_proxy npm-remote
```
